AgentCompass v0.3.5 adds automatic worker continuation for follow-up briefs, calibrates the lightweight System-One classifier cascade without mechanical fallback, slims down injected worker prompt contracts across hosts, and extracts the Cindy and Magpie integrations into standalone plugin repositories.

- **Worker continuation for `--brief` and `--resume`**: `roll --brief` automatically matches and resumes idle, completed Paseo workers owned by the same parent session (by `task_id`, brief path, step/worker tags, and title tokens) instead of spawning a fresh worker on every follow-up turn. `--resume <AGENT_ID>` pins a specific idle worker, `--new-worker` forces a fresh worker, and workers whose historical uncompressed context (`compacted_tokens + context_tokens`) reaches 2M tokens rotate cleanly to a new worker.
- **Slim, idempotent multi-host worker prompts**: Internal hook gate rules moved to `references/parent-address-gate.md`, leaving `references/worker-communication.md` as a concise multi-host worker contract covering both mailbox hosts (Paseo, Herdr, Orca, Claude Code, AGY) and host-managed channels (Cindy, T3, headless CLI, Dot, Grok-bot). `prepare_worker_prompt` is idempotent, and resumed Paseo turns (`prepare_resume_prompt`) send only the new brief plus the parent address footer without repeating the full communication contract.
- **Lightweight System-One cascade & no mechanical fallback**: Default classifier priority now starts with the lightest models (`jev` → `claude-haiku-5-5` → `gpt-6.1-terra` → `gemini-3.8-flash-low`). When all LLM classifiers fail or time out, `roll` returns `status: scorer_unavailable` (`caller_action: parent_autonomous_choice`) so the parent session chooses autonomously rather than routing on a mechanical keyword heuristic.
- **Calibrated `local_only`, difficulty and effort**: Added explicit positive and negative `local_only` examples, tightened `reasoning_depth` and `context_scale` rubrics against brief-length inflation, and recalibrated `effort_allocation` so bounded medium tasks no longer saturate at `xhigh`.
- **Grok usage & tray resilience**: Usage collection reads Grok credits from the CLI billing endpoint without touching its login state, and Usage Float tray controls recover cleanly after transient file errors.
- **Standalone Cindy & Magpie plugins**: Extracted the host-specific plugins into [cindy-agentcompass-plugin](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/cindy-agentcompass-plugin) and [magpie-agentcompass-router](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/magpie-agentcompass-router), documented in `README.md`, `llms.txt`, and `references/herdr.md`.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass/blob/v0.3.5/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Customize the reference fleet and model calibration for your own subscriptions.
